rules: Keep the terracotta colour (#DA7758 as sampled), blocky 12×8 pixel silhouette, two black square eyes, side extensions and four lower appendages.
Never recolour it blue or violet, smooth it, add a human face or make it 3D.
Composite the approved SVG poses; do not ask image models to redraw it.
Show it as a guide: introducing, pointing, reacting or presenting a tip.
